snippet.title: Sesame Street Mecha Builders App
snippet.description:
Download it free from the App Store, Google Play and Amazon: https://l.ead.me/behVBO

Join Sesame Street’s Mecha Builders for all kinds of fun adventures using science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM). This preschool app is designed to ignite young minds with superhero-powered excitement! We have thoughtfully crafted STEM challenges to engage, educate, and inspire children aged 2 to 6, making sure to also nurture their curiosity, imagination, and creativity. Let’s get going—it’s time for your little one to have fun learning through play!

This app is based on Mecha Builders, a CGI-animated spin-off of Sesame Street that reimagines Elmo, Cookie Monster, and Abby Cadabby as robot heroes-in-training who use their STEM superpowers to solve larger-than-life problems. Using their signature special, robo skills, the Mecha Builders are here to help—it just might take them a few tries before they save the day!

KEY FEATURES

STEM Superheroes: Navigate the Mecha pals through playful activities where they use their special powers to solve STEM-based challenges. Watch as your little ones explore STEM through playful interactive challenges and games.

Creative Odyssey: Our app places a strong emphasis on creativity—giving budding artists the chance to draw, paint, explore colors, and more. An ever-expanding range of activities will include further opportunities for creativity, including music.

Explorative Play: We believe in the magic of open play, where children are free to create, experiment, and discover at their own pace. Sesame Street Mecha Builders provides a nurturing environment that encourages open-ended exploration, empowering kids to shape their own learning journey, and develop a deep sense of wonder.

Emotional Development: Beyond STEM, our app aims to help cultivate vital life skills. We have seamlessly woven opportunities to help kids’ develop their resilience, persistence, and self-expression into the fabric of the app. 

Parent Support: The SESAME STREET MECHA BUILDERS app provides support to inform parents about the app and how to help kids get the most out of it. Multi-touch functionality allows parents to play with their kids and join in their STEM adventures! With our app, you'll witness firsthand the transformative power of learning through play.

JOIN OUR STEM ADVENTURE TODAY!
